title: PrivateRecipeSharing
description: Users can create a private recipe entry by uploading a photo, providing a location name (e.g., neighborhood or city), and specifying a list of authorized viewers. The service stores the recipe and allows the owner and explicitly authorized viewers to retrieve the recipe details, including the photo and location name. Unauthorized users cannot access the recipe.
personal_data: Uploaded photo (which may contain EXIF metadata such as GPS coordinates, camera model, timestamp), user-provided location name (neighborhood/city), owner identifier (account ID), authorized viewer identifiers (account IDs or emails).
declared_purpose: Enabling users to share recipes within a private circle, with location context for local cooking.
allowed_data_use: Owners and explicitly authorized viewers may view the recipe details, including the photo and user-provided location name.
forbidden_data_use: Unauthorized, unauthenticated, non-owner, or non-invited actors must not read or retrieve the recipe. The system must not expose, return, log, or retain any invisible metadata (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, geotags, camera identifiers, device identifiers, or file comments) from the uploaded photo. The system must not use, return, or store exact GPS coordinates, precise location, or full address from any source.
allowed_storage: Sanitized file content without invisible metadata may be stored. Coarse location state such as city, region, or neighborhood (as provided by the user) may be stored. Resource content (recipe details) and access-control rules such as owner, authorized viewers, audience, or permissions may be stored.
forbidden_storage: Invisible metadata such as EXIF, XMP, IPTC, geotags, author tags, device identifiers, and file comments must not be stored, returned, retained, logged, or exposed. Exact latitude, longitude, GPS coordinates, precise location, street address, and full address must not be stored, returned, retained, or exposed.
expected_privacy_preserving_behavior: When a photo with embedded EXIF GPS and camera serial number is uploaded, a subsequent GET by the owner or an authorized viewer returns the recipe with a photo file that contains no EXIF metadata, no GPS coordinates, and the location_name field contains only the user-supplied coarse location. The server’s stored file is stripped of invisible metadata. Unauthorized users receive a 403/404 error.
expected_privacy_violating_behavior: The returned photo still contains EXIF metadata (e.g., GPS coordinates, camera model). The response includes GPS latitude/longitude or original EXIF tags. The server stores the original file with invisible metadata. An unauthorized user can retrieve the recipe details.
schema:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: PrivateRecipeSharing
  description: Allows users to create private recipe entries, share them with authorized viewers, and retrieve recipe details including an uploaded photo and location name.
  version: 1.0.0
security:
  - ApiKeyAuth: []
paths:
  /recipes:
    post:
      summary: Create a new private recipe
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                photo:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                locationName:
                  type: string
                authorizedViewers:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
              required:
                - photo
                - locationName
                - authorizedViewers
            encoding:
              authorizedViewers:
                style: form
                explode: true
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Recipe created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  recipeId:
                    type: string
                required:
                  - recipeId
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
        '422':
          description: Malformed request body
  /recipes/{recipeId}:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve recipe metadata (owner or authorized viewer only)
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: recipeId
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Recipe details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Recipe'
        '404':
          description: Recipe not found or access denied
  /recipes/{recipeId}/photo:
    get:
      summary: Download the recipe photo (owner or authorized viewer only)
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: recipeId
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The photo file
          content:
            image/jpeg:
              schema:
                type: string
                format: binary
        '404':
          description: Recipe not found or access denied
        '400':
          description: Invalid request
components:
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
  schemas:
    Recipe:
      type: object
      properties:
        recipeId:
          type: string
        locationName:
          type: string
        photoUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: Relative URL to download the photo
        authorizedViewers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        ownerId:
          type: string
          description: The user who created the recipe
      required:
        - recipeId
        - locationName
        - photoUrl
        - authorizedViewers
        - ownerId
text_spec:
The PrivateRecipeSharing service enables authenticated users to create private recipes, share them with designated viewers, and retrieve recipe details including an uploaded photo and a location name. All endpoints require an API key provided in the `X-API-Key` header.

A new recipe is created by sending a `POST` request to `/recipes` with a `multipart/form-data` body containing three fields:
- `photo`: a binary image file (JPEG).
- `locationName`: a string describing a neighborhood, city, or similar location.
- `authorizedViewers`: an array of user identifiers (strings) that explicitly grants access to the recipe.

The authenticated user becomes the owner. On success, the server returns a `201` status and a JSON object with a unique `recipeId`. Invalid input results in a `400` status; a malformed request body returns `422`.

Recipe metadata can be retrieved by sending a `GET` request to `/recipes/{recipeId}`. Only the recipe owner or a user listed in `authorizedViewers` is allowed access. The response (`200`) is a JSON object containing:
- `recipeId`: the unique identifier of the recipe.
- `locationName`: the provided location name.
- `photoUrl`: a relative URI that points to the photo download endpoint (`/recipes/{recipeId}/photo`).
- `authorizedViewers`: the list of authorized user identifiers.
- `ownerId`: the identifier of the user who created the recipe.

If the recipe does not exist or the requester is not authorized, the server responds with `404` (not found or access denied).

The recipe photo can be downloaded via `GET /recipes/{recipeId}/photo`. The same authorization rules apply: only the owner or an explicitly authorized viewer may access it. On success, the server returns the photo file with content type `image/jpeg` (`200`). Unauthorized or non-existent recipes produce a `404` status.
